name: 单面板多曲线光谱+峰标 (Single-Panel Multi-Spectrum: EPR / UV-Vis)
when: Overlaying 2-4 unstacked curves in a single axes frame (sharing true baseline/intensity) with peak vertical dashed guides, rotated peak labels, or EPR hyperfine g||/A|| comb brackets and g_perp markers.

required_slots.x: Continuous field/wavelength axis (Magnetic field in G for EPR; Wavelength in nm for UV-Vis).
required_slots.series: 1..4 numeric y-columns plotted on the same axis without artificial vertical stacking offsets.

optional_slots.comb_brackets: EPR hyperfine quartet bracket spec: teeth x-positions, baseline/top y, label (e.g. g_||=2.38, A_||=149 G).
optional_slots.peak_vlines: Vertical dashed lines + rotated wavenumber/wavelength labels (e.g. 209, 258, 724 nm in UV-Vis).

data_contract.y_meaning: Signal intensity (a.u.) or Absorbance / F(R) (a.u.) with suppressed numeric y-ticks.
constraints: Do NOT normalize curves independently; EPR and UV-Vis compare relative intensity across Cu loadings.
FigS7 original PDF is large format (8.49 x 7.46 in, 611x537 pt) with bold scaled typography (36pt labels, 26pt ticks, 3.96pt frames/curves) — scale fonts/lines cleanly to match 1:1 visual weight!
For Fig5A EPR: render g_// and g_perp subscripts cleanly in bold mathtext (g$_{//}$=2.38, A$_{//}$=149 G, g$_{\perp}$=2.08) and align comb teeth to actual hyperfine quartet peaks.

notes: Fig5A (left panel of 7.09x2.93 in Fig5): 3 curves (Catalyst-A #6699BA, Catalyst-B #CCA8E3, Catalyst-C #8CCF8C), bottom-left legend, NO minor ticks on x-axis, g||=2.38 A||=149G comb bracket + g_perp=2.08.
FigS7 (8.49x7.46 in): UV-Vis-DRS 200-800 nm, 3 bold spectra (#6699BA, #CCA8E3, #8CCF8C), vertical dashed lines + bold peak labels at 209, 258, 724 nm, top-right legend.
Raw .spc files (data/raw_epr/ and 11_UV-Vis/) are bare float arrays without embedded x-axes; pair with .par or exported .txt/.csv/.xlsx.
